text: The Asian Tour had been in partnership with LIV Golf since the league's 2022 launch, with the PIF-funded International Series as a key part of LIV's promotion and relegation; on 21 July 2026 the PGA Tour and DP World Tour announced the partnership would extend to the Asian Tour with immediate effect, ending the LIV arrangement, with DP World Tour returning to co-sanction Asian Tour events from 2027.
short: Asian Tour ended its LIV Golf partnership and joined the PGA/DP World Tour alliance on 21 July 2026.
